summary: Frontend-only test of CEO AI intelligent onboarding tour (CEOTour). All 8 test cases passed at desktop 1920x900. Login, manual tour trigger, all 7 steps in order, sector personalization (restauração), final CTA navigation to /financas, PUT /api/settings persistence, no auto-open after completion, X skip, and inline 'Saltar' skip all work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: CEOTour.jsx: checkedRef.current is set true BEFORE the GET /api/settings resolves; if the request fails or network is slow the ref still blocks any retry. Acceptable but note.
finishTour ignores PUT /api/settings failure silently (.catch(() => {})). Consider surfacing a toast if persistence fails so the tour doesn't loop next login.

Auto-start path checks tour_completed on every render where user/pathname change; because checkedRef is a component-instance ref, it resets on unmount. If user navigates away and returns to '/', the check re-runs (fine because backend returns tour_completed=true). No bug, just note.
seed_data_creation: None. Test toggled tour_completed via the UI itself (finishTour, skip variants each fired PUT /api/settings).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) manual restart-tour-btn opens overlay; (2) welcome step greets 'Olá, Diego'; (3) full sequence welcome→painel→prioridade→saude→chat→relatorio→final via tour-next-btn; (4) sector copy for restauração matched ('food cost', 'ocupação de mesas', 'turnos', 'restaurantes', 'ementa'); (5) final CTA navigates to /financas AND closes overlay AND fires PUT /api/settings tour_completed:true; (6) after reload of '/', overlay does NOT auto-open; (7) tour-skip-btn (X) closes overlay without navigation and fires PUT; (8) tour-skip-inline on intermediate steps closes overlay and fires PUT. Total 3 PUT /api/settings observed across skip/finish variants. Auto-open on first login also fired (before we dismissed it) — confirmed the auto-start path works when tour_completed=false.
